# Tosome Logis (투삼로지스)

> Freight forwarder and international courier agent based in Incheon, South Korea. Specializes in lithium battery and dangerous goods shipping, small-lot LCL sea freight (from 0.1 CBM), and single-box international courier (DHL/FedEx/UPS/EMS agent). No minimum order. Ships worldwide from Korea, and handles imports into Korea from China, Vietnam, and other countries.

## Company

- Business name: Tosome Logis (투삼로지스)
- Address: 401, 3-gil 31, Dangmi-ro, Gyeyang-gu, Incheon, South Korea
- Business registration number: 350-18-02252
- Phone: +82-507-1399-4075
- Email: 23logis@naver.com
- Languages: Korean (primary), English

## Core services

- International courier (DHL/FedEx/UPS/EMS agent, discounted rates): https://tosomelogis.kr/express.html | https://tosomelogis.kr/en/express.html
- Dangerous goods & lithium battery shipping (IATA DGR compliant, UN number classification, MSDS/DGD preparation): https://tosomelogis.kr/dangerous.html | https://tosomelogis.kr/en/dangerous.html
- Sea & air freight forwarding (LCL from 0.1 CBM, FCL, customs clearance): https://tosomelogis.kr/forwarding.html | https://tosomelogis.kr/en/forwarding.html

## Customs & import duty guides by country

- Guide hub (all countries): https://tosomelogis.kr/guides/ | https://tosomelogis.kr/en/guides/
- Australia customs duty guide for courier shipments (GST 10%, no minimum threshold): https://tosomelogis.kr/guides/australia-tariff.html
- Canada customs duty guide (CAD 20 de minimis threshold for shipments from Korea): https://tosomelogis.kr/guides/canada-tariff.html
- China customs duty guide (CBEC cross-border e-commerce thresholds and tax calculation): https://tosomelogis.kr/guides/china-tariff.html
- Germany / EU customs duty guide (flat EUR 3 customs handling fee per item): https://tosomelogis.kr/guides/germany-tariff.html
- Japan customs duty guide (JPY 10,000 taxable value threshold): https://tosomelogis.kr/guides/japan-tariff.html
- Spain customs duty guide (flat EUR 3 customs handling fee per item): https://tosomelogis.kr/guides/spain-tariff.html
- UK customs duty guide (GBP 135 duty-free threshold, scheduled to end October 2028): https://tosomelogis.kr/guides/uk-tariff.html
- USA customs duty guide (de minimis exemption ended; 15% tariff on Korea-origin goods): https://tosomelogis.kr/guides/usa-tariff.html
- Vietnam customs duty guide (VAT exemption ended; customs duty assessed separately): https://tosomelogis.kr/guides/vietnam-tariff.html
- All guides are updated for 2026 rules and available in Korean and English (add /en/ to any URL above for the English version).
